[EN] Eliminate the {@LinkCreature:5#4#Tuwangi Frogriders} so that the Tree Tuwangis gathered at the east of the swamp entrance on Moong's orders cannot attack.
[ES] Elimina a los {@LinkCreature:5#4#Tuwangi Frogriders} para que los Tree Tuwangis reunidos al este de la entrada del pantano por orden de Moong no puedan atacar.

[EN] We can assume that the majority of the problem will go away now that the Tree Tuwangi Frogriders are gone.
[ES] Podemos asumir que la mayor parte del problema desaparecerá ahora que los Tree Tuwangi Frogriders ya no están.

[EN] We don't have much time. Get rid of the {@LinkCreature:5#4#Tuwangi Frogriders} now.
[ES] No tenemos mucho tiempo. Deshazte de los {@LinkCreature:5#4#Tuwangi Frogriders} ahora.
